plants.credit_line: Rooibos (Aspalathus linearis), Clanwilliam, Western Cape. Photo: Winfried Bruenken (Amrum), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.5.
plants.why: Clear Clanwilliam field photograph of flowering stems and needle-like leaves with explicit species identification.

plants.credit_line: Round-leaved buchu (Agathosma betulina), Cederberg, Western Cape. Photo: Margriet B. (iNaturalist / Wikimedia Commons), CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: Field photo labelled Agathosma betulina showing flower and leaves; not a product photo.
plants.notes: Koehler Medizinal-Pflanzen plate of Agathosma betulina on Commons is Public domain but only about 401x594 px (thumbsize); unsuitable for print, so the iNaturalist field photo was preferred.

plants.credit_line: Aloe ferox Mill. Plate 32 from A. P. de Candolle, Plantarum historia succulentarum (Histoire des plantes grasses), drawn by Pierre-Joseph Redouté, 1802. Biodiversity Heritage Library via Wikimedia Commons (public domain).
plants.why: Historic Redouté plate correctly identified as Aloe ferox Mill., BHL scan via Commons, print-ready resolution.
